name: Radio from Beyond
source:
Radio from Beyond is a short visual novel anthology.

The first tale presents us a lonely boy, who befriends the mysterious creature from beneath his bed one night. The child will have to discover, that the friendship with the unknown may lead to an unexpected outcome.

The second story will tell you about a very determined girl, who went deep into a dark and dense forest in search of a legendary flower, believing it held the power, which would allow her to seek revenge against those, who abused her. But does revenge ever truly lead to a happy end?

In the final of the broadcast the story of an isolated and lonely guy will be told. What mysteries does he keep hidden, and how does he connect to the radio show?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240105203826/https://shreibikus.itch.io/radio-from-beyond]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来自彼岸的广播是一部简短的视觉小说选集。

第一个故事向我们展示了一个孤独的男孩，一天晚上他在床下与这个神秘的生物成为了朋友。孩子必须发现，与未知的友谊可能会带来意想不到的结果。

第二个故事将讲述一个非常坚定的女孩，她深入黑暗而茂密的森林寻找传说中的花朵，相信它拥有力量，这将使她能够向那些虐待她的人复仇。但复仇真的能带来幸福的结局吗？

节目的最后将讲述一个孤独的人的故事。他隐藏着什么秘密，他又是如何与广播节目联系起来的？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240105203826/https://shreibikus.itch.io/radio-from-beyond]itch.io[/url]]
